name: Merchant Call settings expose the PRD scheduling rules
description:
Objective: Merchant Call settings expose the PRD scheduling rules.
Preconditions: Open Merchant call workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Merchant call workflow.
2. Merchant Call settings expose the PRD scheduling rules.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: PRD 6.1, 6.2 and 6.9 global scheduling configuration (editor cancelled).
descriptionHtml:
Objective: Merchant Call settings expose the PRD scheduling rules.
Preconditions: Open Merchant call workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:

  1. Open Merchant call workflow.
  2. Merchant Call settings expose the PRD scheduling rules.
  3. Observe the resulting state.
    Expected: PRD 6.1, 6.2 and 6.9 global scheduling configuration (editor cancelled).
statusMessage:
AssertionError: Merchant Call settings PRD gaps:
  - 6.9 'Buffer Time' renamed to 'Buffer Time (before call)': absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
  - 6.1/6.9 eligible Merchant-Call Underwriter pool for round robin: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
  - 6.1/6.2 maximum booking window (1 week by default): absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
  - 6.9 Monday to Sunday working hours with batch edit: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
assert not ["6.9 'Buffer Time' renamed to 'Buffer Time (before call)': absent from the Merchant Call settings editor", '6.1/6.9 e... settings editor', '6.9 Monday to Sunday working hours with batch edit: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor']
statusTrace:
tests/e2e/merchant_call/test_merchant_call_workflow.py:261: in test_settings_expose_prd_scheduling_rules
    assert not gaps, "Merchant Call settings PRD gaps:\n- " + "\n- ".join(gaps)
E   AssertionError: Merchant Call settings PRD gaps:
E     - 6.9 'Buffer Time' renamed to 'Buffer Time (before call)': absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
E     - 6.1/6.9 eligible Merchant-Call Underwriter pool for round robin: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
E     - 6.1/6.2 maximum booking window (1 week by default): absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
E     - 6.9 Monday to Sunday working hours with batch edit: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor
E   assert not ["6.9 'Buffer Time' renamed to 'Buffer Time (before call)': absent from the Merchant Call settings editor", '6.1/6.9 e... settings editor', '6.9 Monday to Sunday working hours with batch edit: absent from the Merchant Call settings editor']
